title: Rectangular bar
spec: To construct the first part, start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. This sketch consists of a single loop made up of four lines. The first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and extends to (0.75, 0.0). The second line runs from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0607). The third line moves from (0.75, 0.0607) to (0.0, 0.0607), and the fourth line completes the loop by returning to the origin. After drawing the sketch, apply a scale factor of 0.75 to reduce its size proportionally. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero and translating it with a vector also set to zero. To create the three-dimensional model, extrude the sketch 0.013 units in the positive normal direction, ensuring that no extrusion occurs in the opposite direction. This operation results in a new solid body. The final part, named the rectangular bar, has a length of 0.75 units, a width of 0.0606936416184971 units, and a height of 0.013005780346820811 units. The bar features a flat top and bottom, with a slight thickening at the ends.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0607) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0607) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the rectangular bar
r = r.extrude(0.013)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0.0607).lineTo(0, 0.0607).close()

# Extrude the sketch
extrusion = sketch.extrude(0.013)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation (if needed)
# In this case, the coordinate system is the default (0, 0, 0) with no rotation, so no transformation is needed.

# Final model
r = extrusion

# Simple flat rectangular plate

    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(0.75, 0.0607, 0.013)
    .edges("|Z")
    .chamfer(0.001)
)
